headline: Dawn keeps one sleeve rolled.
body: A newsagent's shutter lifts two inches and thinks again. The river has the look of a desk that was not cleared. Somewhere a radio warms up without finding a voice.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one taxi idling, heater fogging the glass

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: bakery oven glow through a side door
